landing.title: Media pipeline
landing.lead: Every image becomes a resize job and every video a frames or transcoding job: the scheduler queues it, a worker processes it, results land in storage.

images.title: Images
images.body: Upload a photo and get WebP sizes for thumbnails, pages and full screen.

video.title: Video
video.body: Pull a preview frame and frames at an interval, or transcode to H.264 at 480p and 720p.

library.title: Library
library.body: Every original sits next to all of its versions: watch, download or delete them in one place.

api.title: API and webhooks
api.body: Scripts work with API keys from the settings; a signed webhook says when a job is done.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the page has moved.

routeError.title: This page failed to load
routeError.body: A new version may have been deployed. Reload to get it.
